name: Hot honey-clove syrup
description: Heat a pan over medium and briefly warm 2 whole cloves until aromatic. Add 2 cups of water, 2 cups of honey, and 1/4 of sliced jalapeño. Stir gently. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and allow to cool completely. Strain out the solids and store the syrup in a sealed container in the fridge for up to one week.
